preference.reason: Both posts are accurate and well structured. X covers the paper's central evidence for the selection mechanism: the Δ/B/C, state-dimension and A-init ablation tables, plus the recipe-vs-architecture caution. It also gives a correct worked numeric example of Δ gating, has fewer broken seams and has no unsupported claim. Y has richer appendix tables (induction heads with params, the full SC09 table, the U-Net ablation, the S4/S6 shape table) and a sharper closing. But Y drops the core selection ablations, leaves the first scaling figure undescribed, has two dangling seams (L228, L245), and overstates compute control for audio (L414). The margin is modest.
